description: Local UI Server Function input: switch one manual login profile to the automated login in one save (FM2e; fewer manual steps design 3A.4): the profile revision the screen read, the three login selectors (maxLength is MAX_SUCCESS_SELECTOR_LENGTH; the selector rules are checked by validateAuthSetup), and the test credential (user name and password, the password twice; maxLength is MAX_CREDENTIAL_VALUE_LENGTH; the value rules are checked again by the credential store). The values are encrypted by the credential store and never returned.
